title: Bacoor pet crematorium may face raps after 29 animal remains found in Bulacan
summary: The remains of 27 dogs and two cats were discovered inside sacks and plastic bags in a vacant lot in Barangay Minuyan Proper, San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan, on Friday morning, prompting a police…

blocks.text: The remains of 27 dogs and two cats were discovered inside sacks and plastic bags in a vacant lot in Barangay Minuyan Proper, San Jose del Monte City, Bulacan, on Friday morning, prompting a police investigation into the suspected improper disposal of animal remains and a possible scam.
